title: Panel Request 0.1
description: An exact user request for an external Agent to interpret. No defaults, parsed business facts, or success claims are inserted.
$comment: src/planning-context.mjs is authoritative for validation and preserving the original text. String lengths are Unicode code points, not UTF-16 offsets. CR, LF and tabs are permitted in text; other control characters and lone surrogates are rejected. Runtime snapshot checks also reject non-JSON values, accessors, cycles and custom prototypes. This schema does not validate natural-language meaning.
